description: FranklinWH aGate: extension registers as neutral labels N1-N11 and rules R1-R5 (docs/design.md sections 3 and 3a).

quirks.reason: Battery DC current always read 0 on an aGate X (V10R01B04D00), although the PICS lists it as implemented. Hidden so 0 A is not shown as a real current. Not yet checked on V12R02B60D00: switch this off if your aGate reports a real current.
Per-port battery DC current, hidden as 714.DCA.
Unimplemented in the PICS, but the device returns values: 'PV clipped' was seen at night 12 times out of 13.
quirks.source: SunSpec PICS SM-000028 (701.DERMode unimplemented); franklinwh-modbus-bridge docs/vendor-issues.md sections 10 and 12d, commit f560db9 (MIT)

constants.name: battery_idle_band_w
constants.reason: Battery power within this band counts as idle (STATE_DEADBAND_W).

constants.name: coarse_step_w
constants.reason: 15506 steps; 16000 is trusted once it shows a value that is not a multiple of this.

constants.name: rating_min_plausible_w
constants.reason: A battery rating below this is taken to be in 100 W units (MIN_PLAUSIBLE_RATING_W).

constants.name: rating_scale_fix
constants.reason: Factor for a rating reported in 100 W units (an aGate X with two aPower 2 reported 160/192 for 16000/19200 W, hilman2 issue #149).

rules.label: Home load power
rules.reason: N1, R2: 16000 once it has shown a value that is not a multiple of 100 W; until then 15506. On an aGate X 16000 moved in 1000 W steps, so one reading cannot tell them apart.

rules.label: Solar on local inverter fitted
rules.reason: N5: 15500. Only 0 and 1 are known; any other value fails.

rules.label: Solar on remote inverter fitted
rules.reason: N5: 15501. Only 0 and 1 are known; any other value fails.

rules.label: Battery operating mode
values: Emergency backup: the battery is kept full for outages
Self-consumption: the battery covers the home from solar
Time of use: the battery follows the tariff schedule
rules.reason: N7, R5: 15507. 1, 2 and 3 measured with the app in each mode on V12R02B60D00; no other value has been read.

rules.label: Battery reserve, time of use
rules.reason: N8: 15509. Holds the TOU reserve on V12R02B60D00 only.

rules.label: Battery inverter state
rules.formula: 'idle' if st in [0, 1, 6, 7] else ('charging' if p < -battery_idle_band_w else ('discharging' if p > battery_idle_band_w else 'idle'))
values: Idle: the inverter rests or the battery power is within the idle band
rules.reason: N9, R1: idle while 701.InvSt is OFF, SLEEPING, FAULT or STANDBY; otherwise from 714.DCW and the idle band. An aGate with two aPower 2 reported 100 W while InvSt said STANDBY (hilman2 issue #149).

rules.label: Grid connection status
values: Seen for about 2 minutes after the aGate was unreachable (one report, unconfirmed)
Connected to the grid (read on every on-grid poll)
Off grid (bridge reports on V10, unconfirmed)
A power dispatch is active (bridge reports on V10, unconfirmed)
rules.reason: N10, R4: 15016. Values seen at one site only; only 2 is read routinely.

rules.label: Battery charge rating
rules.formula: v * rating_scale_fix if 0 < v < rating_min_plausible_w else v
rules.reason: R3: an aGate X with two aPower 2 reported its rating in 100 W units; ratings already in watts are left as they are.

rules.label: Battery discharge rating
rules.formula: v * rating_scale_fix if 0 < v < rating_min_plausible_w else v
